blockers.detail: CSV Single used one qualified Coordinator call, then the core 4-file Worker hit finish_reason=length at exactly 6000 output tokens on the initial attempt and both allowed affected-unit retries. No files were accepted, downstream nodes remained blocked, and the live sequence stopped before Seeded Repair or CSV repeatability.
The budget ledger retains request IDs and token totals for failed Worker calls, but BlueprintUnitExecutor does not append GatewayCompletionError selection evidence to provider_calls.json.

Boundary and security profiles fail the same existing consumer-governance test because its strict verification leaves the temporary fixture dirty before record(); fault and local-functional profiles pass.
